text_block_list.text:
The Champions Cup is held at Chukyo

Racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This racecourse, which also hosts several
popular
turf races, is bustling with
spectators today. Its
stalls are filled to
just under maximum capacity.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The boisterous cheering even reaches
Smart
Falcon in the waiting room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Y-you know, I think I'm actually feeling...
super
nervous?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It's just... It's been a long time since I've
felt like
this.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Things have been going great, but what
if today's
the day I mess up?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
What if I don't win, even when
everyone's
cheering me on?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. That's helped my
nerves a
little!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
You're right... I want to sparkle today.
And I'm
not letting go of that feeling.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna shine like never before!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
